Like or NotLike Without Wildcards
Identifier: like-notlike-without-wildcards
Line: 15, Position: 13, Path: properties.policyRule.if.allOf[1].like
Documentation: https://github.com/Azure/azure-policy-linter/blob/main/docs/Rules/like-notlike-without-wildcards.md
The condition uses the 'like' operator with value 'Canonical' which contains no wildcard (*). Use 'equals' for exact matching.
